reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance; schedule-template now calls getScheduledAmount instead of its own op === 'isbetween' dispatch.

duplication.why: The approximate worst case is defined once (getWorstCaseApproxAmount) and reached through one helper; the diff even removes a local dispatch.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts, but threading the op through the same helper that display components use puts a planning rule into display code paths.

scope.why: Besides the planning paths, it changes the display/search amount in SchedulesTable's 'Approximately X' cell and the mobile list filters, which the request did not ask for.

maintainability.why: One helper is easy to follow, but getScheduledAmount now conflates nominal and worst-case amounts, and inserting amountOp before the positional inverse flag makes the signature easy to misuse.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount (via getWorstCaseApproxAmount) in shared/schedules.ts, used by preview, posting, rule actions, forecast, budget templates, API and UI.
